thought.text: App dev server is up (200). Now start the CMS dev server (app keeps running in the background):

reasoning_content: The app dev server is running on port 43189 and responding with 200. Memory usage is now 5.2GB with 2.4GB available, so I'm ready to start the CMS dev server while keeping the app running in the background.

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/serve-cms.log
setsid nohup just serve --apps=cms < /dev/zero > /tmp/serve-cms.log 2>&1 &
echo "cms serve pid $!"
sleep 15; tail -2 /tmp/serve-cms.log
